 Follow Us On: News Cities Delhi CBI arrests 2 Narcotics Bureau officials for bribe demand from medical shop owner CBI arrests 2 Narcotics Bureau officials for demanding bribe from medical shop owner
 Two NCB sub-inspectors were arrested for allegedly demanding a Rs 25 lakh bribe from a medical shop owner to avoid implicating him in a narcotics case.
 Advertisement The NCB officers sought bribe to spare medical shop owner in drug case. (Photo: Representional image) By: India Today News Desk New Delhi , Nov 16, 2026 20:51 IST Last Updated Nov 16, 2026 20:51 IST Published by India Today Web Desk Nov 16, 2026 20:51 IST Edited by Ajmal Abbas The Central Bureau of Investigation has arrested two Narcotics Control Bureau sub-inspectors for allegedly demanding a Rs 25 lakh bribe from a medical shop owner to avoid implicating him in a narcotics case.
 The CBI arrested Ajit Singh Meena and Sumeet Kumar in Delhi's RK Puram area after laying a trap, officials told news agency PTI.
 The probe agency had registered an FIR against Meena, a sub-inspector posted with the NCB's Delhi Zonal Unit, under the Prevention of Corruption Act.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story The complainant, who runs a medical store in Shahjahanpur, alleged that he had received by post in September a notice issued by the NCB's Delhi Zonal Unit on July 16, 2026, under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act. The notice sought documents related to the purchase and sale of Dicyclomine Tramadol HCL capsules. He said he had responded with supporting documents.
 According to the FIR, Meena later visited the medical store with a team and served the same notice again on October 7. The complainant told him that he had already responded and submitted the relevant documents.
 Meena allegedly disregarded the response, threatened the complainant with at least 10 years in prison if he was implicated under the NDPS Act, and directed him to appear at a location in Delhi that would be communicated later.
 “It is further alleged that subsequently, Ajit Singh Meena contacted the complainant through WhatsApp from mobile ...and demanded an undue advantage of Rs 50 lakh for not implicating the complainant in the NDPS case,” the FIR said.
 The FIR said the CBI's discreet verification found that Meena allegedly demanded Rs 25 lakh and agreed to accept Rs 12 lakh as part payment near Munirka Metro Station in Delhi. Acting on the information, the CBI laid a trap and arrested Meena and Kumar in RK Puram, officials told PTI.
 The two NCB sub-inspectors were thus arrested over the alleged demand for a bribe from the Shahjahanpur medical shop owner in return for not implicating him in the narcotics case. - Ends
